id: \bI just gained some new friends. They need to warm up.
en: \bI just gained some new friends. They need to warm up.
it: \bMi sono appena fatto dei nuovi amici. Hanno bisogno di scaldarsi.

id: \bI think Tyrogue and I will get along.
en: \bI think Tyrogue and I will get along.
it: \bCredo che io e Tyrogue andremo d'accordo.

id: \bOh, hello there. You just missed our very exciting Pokémon race.
en: \bOh, hello there. You just missed our very exciting Pokémon race.
it: \bOh, salve. Ti sei appena perso la nostra emozionantissima corsa di Pokémon.

id: \bThe only problem is the winner left without his prize, a Pokémon egg.
en: \bThe only problem is the winner left without his prize, a Pokémon egg.
it: \bL'unico problema è che il vincitore se n'è andato senza il premio, un Uovo Pokémon.

id: \bWould you like this Pokémon egg? I would hate to see it go to waste.
en: \bWould you like this Pokémon egg? I would hate to see it go to waste.
it: \bVorresti questo Uovo Pokémon? Mi dispiacerebbe vederlo andare sprecato.

id: Mr. Shellby
en: Mr. Shellby
it: Mr. Shellby

id: \bTake good care of it!
en: \bTake good care of it!
it: \bAbbine cura!

id: \bOh, you can't carry it with you.
en: \bOh, you can't carry it with you.
it: \bOh, non puoi portarlo con te.

id: \bMake some space in your party and come back.
en: \bMake some space in your party and come back.
it: \bFai un po' di posto nella tua squadra e torna.

id: \bOh. Will I ever find someone to take this egg?
en: \bOh. Will I ever find someone to take this egg?
it: \bOh. Troverò mai qualcuno che prenda quest'Uovo?

id: \bI wonder what that egg will hatch into?
en: \bI wonder what that egg will hatch into?
it: \bChissà cosa nascerà da quell'Uovo?

id: \bI'm not finding much. You get anything?
en: \bI'm not finding much. You get anything?
it: \bNon sto trovando granché. Tu hai preso qualcosa?

id: There are no apricorns.
en: There are no apricorns.
it: Non ci sono Ghicocche.

id: \bThat was a fun race to watch.
en: \bThat was a fun race to watch.
it: \bÈ stata una corsa divertente da guardare.

id: \bI fished up something nice earlier. It's right beside me.
en: \bI fished up something nice earlier. It's right beside me.
it: \bPrima ho pescato qualcosa di carino. È proprio qui accanto a me.

id: \bI don't need the item. Please take it.
en: \bI don't need the item. Please take it.
it: \bNon mi serve lo strumento. Prendilo pure.

id: \bAh, it's you!
en: \bAh, it's you!
it: \bAh, sei tu!

id: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
en: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
it: \bStavamo allevando il tuo Pokémon e, santo cielo, che sorpresa!

id: \bYour Pokémon was holding an Egg!
en: \bYour Pokémon was holding an Egg!
it: \bIl tuo Pokémon aveva con sé un Uovo!

id: \bWe don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
en: \bWe don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
it: \bNon sappiamo come ci sia finito, ma ce l'aveva il tuo Pokémon.

id: \bYou do want it, don't you?
en: \bYou do want it, don't you?
it: \bLo vuoi, vero?

id: \bYou have no room for it right now... Come back when you've made room.
en: \bYou have no room for it right now... Come back when you've made room.
it: \bAl momento non hai spazio... Torna quando ne avrai fatto.

id: \me[Egg get]\PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
en: \me[Egg get]\PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
it: \me[Egg get]\PN ha ricevuto l'Uovo dal signore della Pensione.

id: \bYou take good care of it.
en: \bYou take good care of it.
it: \bAbbine cura, mi raccomando.

id: \bI really will keep it. You do want this Egg, yes?
en: \bI really will keep it. You do want this Egg, yes?
it: \bAllora lo tengo davvero. Lo vuoi questo Uovo, sì?

id: \bWell all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
en: \bWell all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
it: \bVa bene, allora lo prendo io. Grazie.

id: \bThat is, I don't think we'll ever find another...
en: \bThat is, I don't think we'll ever find another...
it: \bCioè, non credo che ne troveremo mai un altro...

id: \bNo, no, I'm sure we'll find another one. I'm definitely sure of it!
en: \bNo, no, I'm sure we'll find another one. I'm definitely sure of it!
it: \bNo, no, sono sicuro che ne troveremo un altro. Ne sono assolutamente certo!

id: \bI'm the Day-Care Man.
en: \bI'm the Day-Care Man.
it: \bSono il Signore della Pensione.

id: \bI help take care of the precious Pokémon of trainers.
en: \bI help take care of the precious Pokémon of trainers.
it: \bAiuto ad accudire i preziosi Pokémon degli Allenatori.

id: \bAny Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
en: \bAny Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
it: \bSe vuoi far allevare un Pokémon, puoi lasciarlo alle cure di mia moglie.

id: \bAh, it's you!\nGood to see you!
en: \bAh, it's you!\nGood to see you!
it: \bAh, sei tu!\nChe piacere vederti!

id: \bYour \v[3] is doing just fine.
en: \bYour \v[3] is doing just fine.
it: \bIl tuo \v[3] sta benissimo.

en: \bYour \v[3] and \v[4] are doing just fine.

id: \bThe two play with other Pokémon rather than with each other...
en: \bThe two play with other Pokémon rather than with each other...
it: \bQuei due preferiscono giocare con altri Pokémon piuttosto che tra loro...

id: \bThe two don't seem to like each other much.
en: \bThe two don't seem to like each other much.
it: \bQuei due non sembrano piacersi molto.

id: \bThe two seem to get along.
en: \bThe two seem to get along.
it: \bQuei due sembrano andare d'accordo.

id: \bThe two seem to get along very well.
en: \bThe two seem to get along very well.

id: \rI can predict the weather.
en: \rI can predict the weather.
it: \rSo prevedere il tempo.

id: \rMaybe I should be a reporter instead.
en: \rMaybe I should be a reporter instead.
it: \rForse dovrei fare la giornalista.

en: \bI just came out from the mountain.
it: \bSono appena uscito dalla montagna.

en: \bThat mountain is hard to climb. There are no natural entrances.
